references.text: Verse 35 gives the exact total (25,100) which completes the summary in verse 46 (25,000) to show the completeness of the judgment against Benjamin.
Compares the initial strength (26,700) with the number of fallen (25,000) to show that almost the entire tribe was wiped out.
Describes Benjamin's misplaced trust and tactics which directly led to the total defeat in verse 46.
